name: Dyfed
description: A planeswalker who agreed to find Yawgmoth a plane for his paradise and was killed by Rebbec's mercy.

timeline.summary: Dyfed cracks a powerstone in half to open a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Dyfed cracked a large powerstone in half to establish a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is brought to Phyrexia by the planeswalker Dyfed, long before the Invasion.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was not so different from Mirrodin until Yawgmoth arrived thousands of years ago, brought there by the planeswalker Dyfed.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth's refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed brings upper-class Thran from Halcyon to Mercadia to keep them safe from Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: brought to Mercadia by the planeswalker Dyfed in an act of compassion

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "Inhabitants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth, a Thran eugenicist, takes over an idyllic world with Dyfed's help and brings his followers there, creating the first Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he brought his followers to this new world, the first Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed visits Glacian and Yawgmoth talks her into finding a plane for his paradise.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agrees to find a plane where Yawgmoth can build his own paradise.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 2: The Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed sends the captured elders to Mercadia at Rebbec's summons, at Glacian's urging.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker brings them to Mercadia , along with about two hundred of their goblin servants.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed opens a permanent portal to an artificial world, which Yawgmoth names Phyrexia and binds himself to, becoming a god.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth binds himself to the plane, becoming a god while staying there.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth stabs Dyfed in the brain with a powerstone dagger, pithing her so she cannot planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth stabs her in the brain with a powerstone dagger

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec frees Glacian's body, kills the vat priests, and gives Dyfed the peace of death.
timeline.quote: giving Dyfed the peace of death as well.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth talks the planeswalker Dyfed into finding a plane for his paradise.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build his paradise.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed opens a portal to Phyrexia, where Yawgmoth binds himself to the plane's core and becomes a god.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth bound himself to the plane within its core, becoming a god while staying there.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth stabs Dyfed with a powerstone dagger and Rebbec mercy-kills her.
timeline.quote: Rebbec removed the powerstone however, mercy-killing Dyfed.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia, and Rebbec built an infirmary there.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec found Dyfed stabbed in the skull for vivisection and removed the knife, letting her die.
timeline.quote: The disgusted Rebbec removed the knife, allowing Dyfed to die

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed arrives in Halcyon, setting off events leading to the empire's downfall.
timeline.quote: The arrival of the planeswalker Dyfed 4 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War set off a series of events

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed finds the artificial plane and Yawgmoth takes control of it, naming it Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He successfully did so and named the plane Phyrexia

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth has Dyfed exile the council to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth called upon Dyfed to exile the council to Mercadia

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed brings Yawgmoth to the plane that would become Phyrexia, where oil already exists.
timeline.quote: Oil was present on the plane that would become Phyrexia when Dyfed brought Yawgmoth there.

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "On Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed visits Glacian; Yawgmoth walks in and talks her into aiding him, and she gifts him an amulet.
timeline.quote: Dyfed fell for the charming words of Yawgmoth and agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build a paradise for all the Thran.

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Aiding Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Yawgmoth seizes the empire, Dyfed takes the imprisoned elders to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agreed to help Glacian, and took the elders, along with several goblin servants, to the plane of Mercadia

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Creating the portal to Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed opens a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia, letting Yawgmoth become its god.
timeline.quote: Dyfed opened a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Creating the portal to Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed confronts Yawgmoth on Phyrexia, is horrified by his experiments, and he stabs her in the skull to stop her planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth, taking advantage of Dyfed's horror, stabbed her in the skull with a powerstone blade

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec finds the tortured Dyfed and kills the priests working on her, allowing her to die.
timeline.quote: Rebbec found the tortured planeswalker and killed the priests working on her, allowing Dyfed to finally die.

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed takes Thran nobles to Mercadia, who later build the city.
timeline.quote: Many years later, the Thran refugees built the powerful city of Mercadia

citation.text: "Mercadia City", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed shows Yawgmoth the plane of Pyrulea.
timeline.quote: A planeswalker named Dyfed appears before Yawgmoth and shows him the plane of Pyrulea .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed takes the imprisoned Elder Council to Mercadia and shows Yawgmoth Phyrexia, opening a stable portal.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth is shown Phyrexia by Dyfed, who opens a stable portal between that plane and Dominaria.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
